name: Mitsubishi Logistics Corporation
summary: Mitsubishi Logistics Corporation provides logistics services in Japan and internationally. It operates through the Logistics and Real Estate segments. The company offers warehousing; port, harbor, international, overland, and maritime transportation; and customs clearance services. It also engages in the development, sale, and operational management of logistics information systems; manages and operates parking lots and shopping centers; and provides condominium management and maintenance services.
